notes: Nebraska minimum wage applies to employers of 4+ employees (DOL table).
Nebraska meal rule covers assembly plants, workshops and mechanical establishments only, not retail (DOL table).
No state paid rest-period requirement in the DOL table; federal law does not require one.
No state daily overtime listed in the DOL table.
Drafted from US DOL WHD state tables (confidence=medium) on 2026-11-06; upgrade to primary sources pending.
State minor-hour limits not yet researched for this state; federal 14-15 limits apply as the floor.
minimum_wage.effective is the DOL table date (2026-11-05), not the statutory effective date.

rules.summary: Nebraska's basic minimum wage is $15.00 an hour (DOL table, Nov. 2026).
